fullContentHtml:
ONGC Geologists and Engineers E1 Result 2026 – Full Details

Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) has released the result for the Geologists and Engineers E1 post. This recruitment was released for 52 posts. Applications for ONGC Geologists and Engineers E1 Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 17 July 2026 to 31 July 2026. The written examination was held from 06 September 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this examination can download their ONGC Geologists and Engineers E1 Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 17 July 2026
  • Last Date : 31 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 06 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 22 August 2026
  • Result : 08 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, PwBD : Rs. 00/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
